pages.text: Some of the fruit grown in Moon's Whatsits can be turned into jam.$(br2)Bakery also adds several more varieties, giving you plenty of different jams to make and use.

pages.title: Whatsits Jams
pages.text: The original Moon's Whatsits jams are Blackberry Jam, Blueberry Jam and Cherry Jam.$(br2)Each is made from its corresponding fruit and sugar.

pages.title: Bakery Jams
pages.text: Bakery adds Strawberry Jam, Sweetberry Jam, Glowberry Jam, Apple Jam and Chocolate Jam.$(br2)These provide additional flavours for use in Bakery foods.
Recipes:$(br)Blackberry Jam: Blackberry + Sugar$(br)Blueberry Jam: Blueberry + Sugar$(br)Cherry Jam: Cherry + Sugar
